_comment: "Roll a 6 sided die. Destroy UP TO X ITEMS, where X is half the number rolled, rounded down." The item restriction was written as target:"ITEM", which DESTROY_PERMANENT reads as a target keyword rather than a subtype, so there was no filter and it destroyed X arbitrary permanents. "Up to" was written as max:true, a third spelling of up_to that was unread, so it destroyed exactly X with no option to stop. And it was scoped to the OPPONENT where the card says items, unqualified. The die had no face count either.
